sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the ship target, canonical owners, CP applicability branches, singular boolean pitchValueKnown constraint, and metre quantity units. Reject the current presence-only encoding: in the CP/pitchValueKnown=false branch, add one bounded DIRECT_CALCULATION formula check comparing propellerPitchAtMcrBollard with 0.7 * propellerPitchAtMcrFreeRunning, using the verified tolerance scaled from the expected result rather than the reported value; do not use exact equality for the derived decimal result or invent unsupported tolerance constants.
